# Open-access art fixtures

Responses for `tests/art_sources_test.py`, so no test touches the network. They follow the shapes
the three APIs document (Art Institute of Chicago `POST /api/v1/search`, The Met `GET /v1.1/search`
and `GET /v1/objects/{id}`, Wikimedia Commons `action=query&generator=images&prop=imageinfo`),
trimmed to the fields Matchy reads plus a few around them. Image ids, the Commons file and its
author are made up. `{BASE}` is replaced with the test server's address; the images themselves are
generated by the test at the sizes it needs.
